items.title: Benefits and Challenges of AI in Society

source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Benefits and Challenges of AI in Society under 8.1 as printed (PDF 108-109, printed 104-105).

blocks.text: AI brings significant benefits to modern life by increasing efficiency, accuracy, and convenience. It can perform repetitive tasks faster than humans, assist doctors in diagnosing diseases, and help farmers monitor crops more effectively. For example, DeepMind's AI can analyze 3D eye scans and help predict eye diseases such as glaucoma before clear symptoms become visible to doctors. In business, companies such as Amazon and Daraz use AI chatbots to answer customer questions, such as “Where is my order?”, for thousands of users at the same time. Businesses also use AI to analyze customer behavior, predict trends, and improve decision-making. AI supports education through personalized learning and adaptive tutoring systems.

Despite these benefits, AI introduces challenges that must be managed carefully. Concerns include data privacy, job displacement, and bias in algorithms that may lead to unfair outcomes. (as shown in Figure 8.2) Ethical issues also arise when AI systems make decisions that affect people's lives. Balancing innovation with responsibility ensures that AI remains a tool that benefits humanity rather than harms it. Understanding these challenges helps promote fair, transparent, and ethical use of AI in all sectors.
